# Third-party (vendor) (`third-party` v1)

An outsourced service provider: criticality, services, concentration and incidents.

**Group:** Operational and non-financial risk · **Mnemonic:** `VEND` · **Identifiers:** `VEND-…` in `vendorId`

Open one with `VEND <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: third-party
version: 1
description: "An outsourced service provider: criticality, services, concentration and incidents."
match: { kind: third-party, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Operational and non-financial risk · Third-party (vendor), id: $.vendorId }
strip:
  - { label: Vendor, bind: $.name }
  - { label: Criticality, bind: $.criticality, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Services, bind: $.serviceCount, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Annual spend, bind: $.annualSpend, fmt: compact }
  - { label: Last assessed, bind: $.lastAssessed, fmt: date }
  - { label: SLA breaches (12m), bind: $.slaBreaches, fmt: amount0 }
panels:
  - id: services
    kind: table
    title: Services
    key: F2
    rows: $.services
    columns:
      - { label: Service, bind: "@.service" }
      - { label: Desk, bind: "@.desk" }
      - { label: Exit plan, bind: "@.exitPlan" }
  - id: incidents
    kind: table
    title: Incidents
    key: F3
    rows: $.incidents
    columns:
      - { label: Date, bind: "@.date", fmt: date }
      - { label: Incident, bind: "@.incident" }
      - { label: Impact, bind: "@.impact", tone: status }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
keys: { F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
